## Highlights

- Package content verification rejects packages whose desktop entry references a missing executable instead of reporting a false success.
- Cached Git repositories are refreshed to the remote default branch before reuse.

## Changes

- Reject packages without the executable named by their desktop entry and never record them as verified recipes.
- Refresh cached repositories to `origin/HEAD` so self-builds pick up the latest source.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hyalcin70/git2pkg/compare/v0.2.0-alpha.29...v0.2.0-alpha.30
